subject: general
question: A man can finish a work in 12 days and a woman can finish the same in 10 days, 2 men and 3 women work on alternate days and men start the first day. The work will be finished in days.
solution:
**Given:**

A man can complete a job in 12 days, and a woman can complete the same job in 10 days. Two men and three women work on alternate days, starting with the men.

**Concept Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

Where, Efficiency = one day work of an individual or group.

**Calculation:**

LCM of 12 and 10 is 60.

Efficiency of Man = 60/12 = 5
